name: Veldtmark Splitpanel Night Operative Set
description: A night-work rig that refuses the all-black cliché with conviction — this ensemble is built in deep navy and weathered wine-red, colors that disappear in M88's sodium-tinged nighttime streetlight better than black ever does against artificial illumination. The structural piece is a long double-breasted coat in deep navy with wine-red interior facing, cut to mid-thigh with mag-detach side panels that can be stripped away in under two seconds to reveal a close-cut silhouette beneath — the full coat reads as a Tier 3 evening coat, the stripped version as a transit worker's coverall layer. The coat's lining is gene-compatible throughout: the rear panel is a full-length split-zip running from collar to hem, with reinforced flex-gussets on either side accommodating tail, wing-stub, or spinal rig configurations without distorting the outer silhouette. Beneath the coat, a fitted long-sleeve top in dark burgundy features two integrated forearm holster bands — flat-profile polymer bands that carry compact sidearms flush against the inner forearm, accessible via a palm-twist release. Trousers are straight-cut in charcoal anthracite with a scanner-resistant weave, carrying six total pockets — two standard, two deep thigh with mag-close, and two hidden rear waistband pockets. Footwear is a mid-calf boot in dark oxblood synthetic leather with a stacked composite heel that adds two centimeters of height — a subtle silhouette change that confounds gait-recognition systems — and a hollow heel compartment sized for a data chip stack or a folded emergency med-patch.
functionality: Mag-detach side panels for rapid silhouette change, gene-compatible full rear split-zip with flex gussets, dual forearm-mount palm-release holster bands, scanner-resistant trouser fabric, gait-disrupting stacked heel with hollow compartment, six total pockets including two hidden waistband
what_it_says: This is an outfit with opinions. The wine-red and navy palette is a statement — this runner isn't hiding what they are, they're just making sure you can't prove it. There's a reputation built into the cut: runners who wear the Veldtmark Splitpanel are known to be thorough, expensive, and deeply uninterested in being chased. The gene-compatible rear split is a statement of professional accommodation — this runner works with everyone.
worn_by: senior contract runners with established reputations
runners with geneware tail or wing modifications
operatives who want to be recognized by peers while remaining anonymous to marks
manufacturer: Veldtmark Street — a respected mid-tier street label with a decade of runner-community trust, known for the Splitpanel line specifically
story_hooks: A gait-recognition system at a private corponation event has been updated with an algorithm that specifically accounts for stacked-heel disruption — someone has been feeding it data on runner counter-measures, and this operative's heel is flagged the moment they cross the threshold.

The mag-detach panels are stripped mid-pursuit through a night market, and the runner realizes the coat's interior — now fully exposed — carries a Veldtmark label with a serial number that a specific corponation security division has been hunting for three months.

Another runner at the same location is wearing the same coat in the same colorway — a coincidence that becomes a crisis when the mark they're both after assumes they're working together, changing every calculation both runners have made for the evening.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sharp, pragmatic night-work ensemble that reads as deliberate anti-surveillance styling. The silhouette is architectural: a long navy coat with wine-red interior creates visual depth and color-shifting depending on movement and angle. When panels are attached, the figure appears formal and corporate-adjacent (Tier 2–3 evening wear); stripped, it transforms into a utilitarian operative rig. The overall impression is controlled, modular, and designed for rapid configuration changes.
physical_description.fit: Tailored but not restrictive. The coat hangs cleanly from the shoulders with a slight taper through the waist; side panels mag-detach without visible hardware. The undershirt fits close but allows layering and arm movement for holster access. Trousers are straight-cut with no taper, maintaining clean lines and pocket functionality. The boot calf hugs without compression, sitting at mid-shin for balance.
physical_description.primary_material: Navy wool-blend outer (Veldtmark proprietary), wine-red lining in treated silk-poly blend. Fitted top in high-stretch burgundy synthweave. Charcoal anthracite scanner-resistant weave trousers (ballistic-grade poly-cotton composite). Oxblood synthetic leather boots with stacked composite heel.
physical_description.texture: The coat outer is smooth with a subtle nap; wine-red interior is glossy and friction-resistant for quick panel removal. The fitted top has a tight knit with barely-visible holster band texture. Trousers show a matte finish with reinforced seams. Boot leather is treated for scuff resistance and has a subtle sheen.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep navy primary with wine-red secondary (interior facing, undershirt, boot). Charcoal anthracite trousers bridge the two tones. No bright accents or branding visible—intentional color erasure against sodium-vapor street lighting.
physical_description.closures: Coat: magnetic snap panels on both sides (removal in <2 seconds), rear split-zip from collar to hem with reinforced flex-gussets. Top: implicit closure (pullover fit). Trousers: standard fly plus mag-close on thigh pockets, friction-fit rear waistband pockets. Boots: side zip with tension locks.
distinctive_features: Mag-detach side panels transforming silhouette between formal and operative in seconds
Full-length rear split-zip with gene-compatible flex-gussets (tail, wing-stub, spinal rig accommodation)
Integrated forearm holster bands with palm-twist release mechanism
Six-pocket configuration (standard, thigh mag-close, hidden rear waistband)
Stacked composite heel (+2cm height) with gait-recognition evasion design
Hollow heel compartment for data chips or emergency med-patches
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional with Tier 2 presentation option. Base rig signals street operative/runner; full coat configuration could pass corporate security.
physical_description.cultural_context: Built for night-work runners, extraction specialists, transit workers operating in surveillance-heavy zones. The dual-mode silhouette appeals to those who need to move between monitored corporate spaces and ungoverned street sectors. Veldtmark's street-community reputation means the wearer is established, trusted, and professional—not desperate or inexperienced.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in but maintained. Veldtmark customers keep gear functional; you'd expect subtle wear at the mag-panel edges, minor scuffing on boot heels, and maybe one carefully-patched seam. The garment is designed to show tactical use, not neglect.
